parts.title: De Isaía Prophéta

verses.text: In die illa erit Dóminus exercítuum coróna glóriæ, et sertum exsultatiónis resíduo pópuli sui;
Et spíritus judícii sedénti super judícium, et fortitúdo reverténtibus de bello ad portam.

Verum hi quoque præ vino nesciérunt, et præ ebrietáte erravérunt: sacérdos et prophéta nesciérunt præ ebrietáte, absórpti sunt a vino, erravérunt in ebrietáte, nesciérunt vidéntem, ignoravérunt judícium.

paragraphs: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.

responsory.text: Egrediétur Dóminus de Samaría ad portam, quæ réspicit ad Oriéntem: et véniet in Béthlehem ámbulans super aquas redemptiónis Judæ:
responsory.repeat: Tunc salvus erit omnis homo: quia ecce véniet.

responsory.text: Et præparábitur in misericórdia sólium ejus, et sedébit super illud in veritáte.
Tunc salvus erit omnis homo: quia ecce véniet.

parts.title: Lesson from the book of Isaias

verses.text: In that day the Lord of hosts shall be a crown of glory, and a garland of joy to the residue of his people:
And a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and strength to them that return out of the battle to the gate.

But these also have been ignorant through wine, and through drunkenness have erred: the priest and the prophet have been ignorant through drunkenness, they are swallowed up with wine, they have gone astray in drunkenness, they have not known him that seeth, they have been ignorant of judgment, erravérunt in ebrietáte, nesciérunt vidéntem, ignoravérunt judícium.

paragraphs: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.

responsory.text: The Lord shall go forth out of Samaria unto the gate that looketh toward the East; and He shall come into Bethlehem, walking upon the waters of the redemption of Judah.
responsory.repeat: Then shall every one be saved for, behold, He cometh.

responsory.text: And in mercy shall His throne be established, and He shall sit upon it in truth.
Then shall every one be saved for, behold, He cometh.

verses.text: Omnes enim mensæ replétæ sunt vómitu sordiúmque, ita ut non esset ultra locus.
Quem docébit sciéntiam? et quem intellígere fáciet audítum? Ablactátos a lacte, avúlsos ab ubéribus.
Quia manda remánda, manda remánda, exspécta reexspécta, exspécta reexspécta, módicum ibi, módicum ibi.
In loquéla enim lábii, et lingua áltera loquétur ad pópulum istum.

paragraphs: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.

responsory.text: Docébit nos Dóminus vias suas, et ambulábimus in sémitis ejus:
responsory.repeat: Quia de Sion exíbit lex, et verbum Dómini de Jerúsalem.

responsory.text: Veníte, ascendámus ad montem Dómini, et ad domum Dei Jacob.

Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.

Matins · Saturday, 12 December 2026

Saturday of the Second Week of Advent

Sabbato infra Hebdomadam II Adventus · Feria major

Read in Latin and English{{listen}}

Lesson I

Lesson from the book of Isaias

Isa 28:4-7

In that day the Lord of hosts shall be a crown of glory, and a garland of joy to the residue of his people: And a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and strength to them that return out of the battle to the gate. But these also have been ignorant through wine, and through drunkenness have erred: the priest and the prophet have been ignorant through drunkenness, they are swallowed up with wine, they have gone astray in drunkenness, they have not known him that seeth, they have been ignorant of judgment, erravérunt in ebrietáte, nesciérunt vidéntem, ignoravérunt judícium.

Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.

$Deo gratias

℟. The Lord shall go forth out of Samaria unto the gate that looketh toward the East; and He shall come into Bethlehem, walking upon the waters of the redemption of Judah. * Then shall every one be saved for, behold, He cometh.

℣. And in mercy shall His throne be established, and He shall sit upon it in truth.

℟. Then shall every one be saved for, behold, He cometh.

Lesson II

Isa 28:8-11

Omnes enim mensæ replétæ sunt vómitu sordiúmque, ita ut non esset ultra locus. Quem docébit sciéntiam? et quem intellígere fáciet audítum? Ablactátos a lacte, avúlsos ab ubéribus. Quia manda remánda, manda remánda, exspécta reexspécta, exspécta reexspécta, módicum ibi, módicum ibi. In loquéla enim lábii, et lingua áltera loquétur ad pópulum istum.

Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.

$Deo gratias

℟. The Lord will teach us of His ways, and we will walk in His paths. * For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

℣. Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob.

℟. For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

Lesson III

Isa 28:12-13

Cui dixit: Hæc est réquies mea, refícite lassum: et hoc est meum refrigérium: et noluérunt audíre. Et erit eis verbum Dómini: Manda remánda, manda remánda, exspécta reexspécta, exspécta reexspécta, módicum ibi, módicum ibi: ut vadant, et cadant retrórsum, et conterántur, et illaqueéntur, et capiántur.

Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.

$Deo gratias

℟. Christ our King cometh. * And John hath testified of Him, that He is the Lamb that should come!

℣. The kings shall shut their mouths at Him, all nations shall serve Him.

℟. And John hath testified of Him, that He is the Lamb that should come!

℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

℟. And John hath testified of Him, that He is the Lamb that should come!
